title: AI’s Existential Fears Meet Wall Street Financing FOMO in Europe
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. are among banks lining up to finance billions of dollars in European AI debt as the region races to close the gap with the US.

title: Microsoft AI Chief Warns Anthropic’s Humanlike Claude Is Risky
summary: Microsoft Corp. artificial intelligence chief Mustafa Suleyman is warning that infusing tools like Anthropic’s Claude with humanlike characteristics increases the risks of such systems going rogue.

title: Bain Capital Ventures Raises $1.6 Billion for Life After AGI
summary: Bain Capital Ventures, the venture arm of private investment firm Bain Capital, has raised $1.6 billion to back new startups focused on the next stage of artificial intelligence.

title: SK Hynix Says Exploring Options After Report of Intel Tie-Up
summary: SK Hynix Inc. said that it’s exploring options to boost its global competitiveness after a report that it may team up with Intel Corp. to make semiconductors in the US.

title: Apple Is Developing Enterprise Server for AI Age, Report Says
summary: Apple Inc. is working on an enterprise server using its own chips and has had discussions with Nvidia Corp. about using its networking equipment, the Information reported.

title: Novo Will Work With Anthropic AI to Speed Drug Development
summary: Novo Nordisk A/S and Anthropic PBC will work together to speed up drug development using artificial intelligence, a key goal as Novo tries to catch up in the cutthroat obesity market.

title: Apollo’s Zelter on AI Capex, ‘Higher for a While’ Rates
summary: Apollo Global Management President Jim Zelter discusses the firm’s partnerships with the New York Yankees and Nvidia, the “unprecedented” scale of the AI capex markets, and why he believes “rates are going to be higher for a while.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Is Making Live Sports More Valuable, Says Liberty Co-Owner Wu Tsai
summary: Clara Wu Tsai, co-owner of the New York Liberty and Brooklyn Nets, explains why sports have become a legitimate asset class and argues that live sports have become increasingly valuable in the age of AI because they offer something unscripted, unpredictable and communal. Wu Tsai joins David Rubenstein for the premiere episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations, Season 12. This interview was recorded June 4, in Brooklyn, New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Blue Energy Submits NRC Application for Texas Nuclear Project
summary: Blue Energy Global Inc. has begun an application to install a small reactor at a Texas power plant it’s developing to supply a Crusoe Inc. data center, which will initially run on natural gas before adding nuclear power.

title: India’s New Fee On UPI Payments Faces Pushback From Brokers, Retailers
summary: Indian retailers and stockbrokers are worried that a new fee on payments through the state-backed digital network could increase costs, squeezing margins.

title: AI-Fueled Profit Growth Set to Flow Through Every S&P 500 Sector
summary: The next earnings season is set to be robust across the board, as the benefits of artificial intelligence spending start to flow across the economy.

title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Touts Himself as an AI VC Role Model
summary: The AI kingmaker also fancies himself a savvy venture capitalist

title: AI Slowdown Calls Collide With Stock Market’s AI Bets
summary: A particularly pointed balancing act for finance and investing executives

title: UK Workers Hide AI Use From Their Bosses, Deloitte Survey Finds
summary: Almost one in ten UK workers have used an AI tool that their employer has banned or would disapprove of, according to a survey by Deloitte that highlights the growing tension between employees and their bosses over using the technology.

title: Mytheresa Owner Sales Rise as Ultra Wealthy Help Luxury Platform
summary: LuxExperience, owner of the e-commerce site Mytheresa, posted a rise in sales as the multibrand platform’s strategy of catering to the ultra wealthy helped it navigate a tough environment for high-end fashion.

title: Meta CEO Zuckerberg Leans on Powell McCormick to Clear Path for AI Push
summary: At a Meta Platforms Inc. board retreat last December, Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg asked Dina Powell McCormick to take a walk with him around his sprawling Kauai compound, known as Koolau Ranch.

title: TikTok Billionaire Becomes Asia’s Richest Person
summary:
ByteDance’s Zhang Yiming has become Asia’s richest person for the first time, marking a comeback for the TikTok developer as fortunes linked to AI surge above the billionaires of traditional industry.

Pui Gwen Yeung has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Coast Guard and FBI Conduct Cyberattack Probes on Tankers
summary: The US is investigating potential cyberattacks on oil and gas tankers, as concerns grow around the threat to maritime safety posed by hackers interfering with vessels’ electronic systems.

title: EU Unveils Social Media Curbs for Kids and Ban on Users Under 13
summary: The European Union is working to ban social media for kids under 13 and restrict the use of technology and artificial intelligence services for older children, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in her annual address Wednesday.

title: SoftBank CDS Hits 3-Year High as OpenAI Risks Stay in Focus
summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s credit default swaps rose to the highest level since 2023 as traders assessed risks surrounding OpenAI, one of SoftBank’s biggest bets.
